candidates.title: JR Central Adds Real-Time Shinkansen Info to NAVITIME App
candidates.what_changed: JR Central has begun providing real-time operation information for the Tokaido Shinkansen within the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' mobile application.

candidates.traveler_action: Download or update the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app to access real-time Tokaido Shinkansen status updates.
